notes.title: POROTO @ PAX EAST 2025!
notes.content:
Hey Poroto Fans! 👋

I'm absolutely buzzing to announce that Poroto will be making its way to PAX East in Boston this May 8-11! 🎉

Get ready to experience our arcade-style 2D platformer that throws a pinball-powered twist into the action! You'll be able to go hands-on with Poroto at Booth 15105 on both PC and Steam Deck.

Come say hi, give Poroto a whirl, and let me know what you think! I can't wait to meet you all!

See you in Boston! 🚀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860749/121dcc68c16f887b367983ac6d94d817031d16c6.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Nominate POROTO for the Steam Awards!
notes.content:
Nominate POROTO for Best Game You Suck At during this Autumn Sale! 

You can also pick a different category that you think better suits the game (it plays great on Steam Deck ːsteamhappyː). Your support is very appreciated!

notes.title: Update Notes for November 6th
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added an "Are you sure?" message when selecting 'Main Menu' after beating a level to avoid accidentally returning to the Main Manu.
[*] Fixed bug in Boss Fight 3 that caused POROTO to disappear unintentionally.
[/list]

notes.title: Watch the Dev play!
notes.content:
As part of Next Fest, Edu will be playing through POROTO, sharing some of his inspirations and decision making for designing the game.
He will also be trying to obtain some of the achievements live, so tune on to find out whether they are actually tough!

notes.title: Boss Fight 3 - Initial design approach
notes.content:
[b][POROTO-TYPING 31-May] [/b]

Boss fights are ways for me to mix up the gameplay throughout the game. Boss Fight 3 will be a side scrolling level flying through...TBD 😉.

These are the early stages of development for it, but I'm glad I landed (pun intended) on an approach for it. What do you think?
